text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though the appointed time arrived, 
Gran Alegria didn't show up for training. 
When I went looking for her... 
surprisingly, she was playing with birds!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
This little bird just pecked me a moment 
ago!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"'Play with mischievous birds with all 
your might!' That's another rule of mine!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Puzzled by the unique personal rule, I 
still warned them to be more careful in 
the future.
